question: Children who own more books score better at school. Should the state post books to families?
answer: Books in a house come with parents who read, time, income and quiet — any of which could do the work. Posting books tests whether the books mattered, and when it has been tried the effect is far smaller than the correlation suggested.
move: The object in the house is rarely the thing doing the work.
trap: A visible thing standing in for everything invisible around it.
